# partiteai_client_task_definition (Data Source)

Client Task Definition data source. Look up an author-defined client task definition by `id` or by `name` (exactly one must be set).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Client task definition identifier. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Client task definition name (the tool name exposed to the LLM). Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `description` (String) Description of the task
- `input_message_type` (String) JSON schema the agent must satisfy when invoking the task
- `output_message_type` (String) JSON schema the user must satisfy when completing the task
- `ui_forms` (Map of String) UIs a client can show to complete the task, keyed by form type, with the form's definition as the value
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated
